svg.title: Entity-Relationship Diagram: Negotiation, Orders, Meetups, and Reviews
svg.text: Entity-Relationship Diagram (Part 2): Offers, Orders, Meetups & Reviews
Reconciled with Migration 0003: unique offer_id & partial unique active product_id allowing clean relisting after cancellation
(a) Context Entities (Referenced from Core Catalog & Identity)
(c) Offline Fulfillment, Audit Trail & Post-Trade Reputation
(1) orders.offer_id is UNIQUE: each accepted offer produces at most one order under concurrent retries.
(2) Partial unique index on orders(product_id) WHERE status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','DISPUTED') allows full historical audit & clean relisting.
